title: [Decision] skills token ratchet: price evals/** out (they never enter a customer context), and make the standing 「先削重复,余额按实测提高」 ruling the gate-recognised path for teaching text — or keep the per-raise ruling round
body:
director#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbQLcy8yg6vhJVXXi8

Ruled: 6513306068 · letter B · 2026-10-30T02:19Z
Ruling-ref: 6513306068

Filing gate ②: a governance choice on an existing gate, asked for by the maintainer in the director summon (2026-10-30, verbatim: 「继续帮我评估这种天花板的价值是什么，为什么要卡住车队的开发进度」) after ruling A on #26940. Filed by the director seat (summon #54 continuation 1, ledger objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*`: triage sets it (`domain:skills` expected — the gate's subject is `skills/**`, a governed face).

## 维护者速读

- **这道天花板是什么：** `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 给 `skills/**` 里每个手写文件钉一个只降不升的 token 上限（85 个文件，合计 217,710 token），新增文字必须在同一文件里删等量文字付账，抬上限只能凭 PR 正文引用的维护者裁决 id。出处是你 2026-08-21 的裁决「10402 需要整体考虑 skills 的长度,不能为了一个小功能扩写很多。」
- **它护的是什么：** 发到客户项目 `.claude/skills/` 里、每个客户会话都会加载的教学文字（SKILL.md、rules、references）。这一半价值是实的：10 月以来 64 次改动，每次加教学都先在同文件里削复述再抬（门禁注释里记了 40 次「先削重复,余额按实测提高」的付账）。
- **它护不到的：** `evals/**`。`skills/README.md` 第 74–75 行自己写明 evals「用于维护者给技能打分，在客户安装里是惰性的」，没有任何 SKILL.md 指向它们——它们不进任何客户上下文，却占 28 个文件、27,897 token（12%）的计价。对 evals 计 token，护的不是客户成本，只是仓库体积。
- **为什么卡住进度：** ① 84 个文件里 47 个余量 ≤1 token、69 个 ≤20 token，上限钉死在当前尺寸，任何合法新增都要先裁后呈；② 你 10-27 已裁「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」，门禁注释里已按它付了 40 次，但门禁头部仍要求「每次抬行引裁决 id」，席位各自判断能不能引常设裁决——#26940 的 dev 因「手上没有裁决 id」停工，skills 席写分析，总监呈批，你回字，一条 154 token 的 eval 走了约 20 小时、三个席位；10 月还有 #26633、#26760、#26764、#26834 四张同样「因为文件顶着上限」的 eval 跟进卡；③ 规则冲突：#26369 裁决 B 要求每次协议新增必补 eval（规则要加），eval 文件上限只降不升（规则禁加），每张协议新增卡都会撞一次。
- **请回：** `A / B / C / D`，席位推荐 **B**。

## Governing text

- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` header L12–20 (the 10402 ruling and the cost model: "`skills/` is loaded WHOLE into customer agent context windows"), L124–131 (shrink-only; a raise lands only in a PR quoting a maintainer ruling), L146–159 (`evals/**` priced as part of what "ships into the customer project together").
- `skills/README.md` L74–75: `evals/` — "skill eval fixtures — used by maintainers to score the skill, inert (but harmless) in consumer installs".
- Maintainer ruling 2026-10-27 on the skills-lane decision card 「skills 修复卡的教学和 eval 都撞 token 天花板,怎么付?」: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (quoted 40 times in the ratchet's row comments as the authorisation of a measured raise).
- #23606 ruling B (2026-10-15, the `.claude/**` LINE ratchet, same question): a ruling of record that orders text into a ratcheted file is itself the authorisation to raise the ceiling by the measured delta; the PR quotes the ruling id and the delta; no second word from the maintainer.
- #26369 ruling B: a protocol addition owes skills, docs and eval.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉 ④: 新增门禁默认否; 门禁是只减不增的零件.

**Protocol statement.** `Metadata-protocol: none`; `Clause-②: no`. The gate script is not a governed path; its subject (`skills/**`) is, so the change rides the skills lane.

## Premises (read at `origin/main` `ded67bfb`)

1. 85 priced rows; 28 under `evals/`; 27,897 of 217,710 tokens. Re-check: `git show origin/main:scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep -E "^\s+\['skills/" | grep -c /evals/` → 28; control: `… | grep -c SKILL.md` → 11.
2. Evals are inert in consumer installs. Re-check: `git show origin/main:skills/README.md | sed -n 74,75p`; `git grep -c "evals/" origin/main -- 'skills/*/SKILL.md'` → 0.
3. Headroom: 47 of 84 readable rows have ≤1 token of headroom, 69 have ≤20. Re-check: for each row, `ceil(bytes/4)` against the row (stamp line excluded on SKILL.md; the count here ignores that exclusion, so SKILL.md rows read 5 tighter than they are).
4. The standing ruling is in reuse: `git show origin/main:scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep -c 先削重复` → 40.
5. Cost of one raise through the ruling round: #26940 — dev blocked 2026-10-29T05:20Z (6488686813) → seat analysis 05:27Z (6488793773) → director brief 10:16Z (6493978216) → ruling 2026-10-30T01:48Z (6512920986); three seats, about 20 hours, for +154 tokens. Four more October cards exist only because a file sat at its ceiling: #26633, #26760, #26764, #26834 (all closed).

## Options

| | What changes | What the team sees | Workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** keep as is | Nothing. Every raise cites a ruling; seats decide case by case whether the 10-27 ruling applies. | Teaching text and evals both pay by deletion; a file at its ceiling sends a card through the decision box. | 0 |
| **B** evals out + standing path in | (i) `evals/**` leaves the ratchet's PRICED population (still MEASURED and printed, like generated files; `check:skill-eval-tokens`' quality gate and the eval self-consistency rules stay). (ii) The header names the 10-27 ruling as the gate-recognised path for `SKILL.md` / `rules` / `references`: a PR that shows deletion of restatement in the same file and quotes that ruling id may move the row by the measured remainder, AT the measurement — no per-card ruling. A raise with no deletion shown and no ruling stays red. | An owed eval never blocks; a teaching addition pays by trimming and lands without a director round; the customer-context ceiling stays shrink-only in substance. | skills · 1 PR (header + population filter + self-test rows) · S · precedent: #23606 B for the line ratchet, #12392 for the population boundary |
| **C** standing path only | (ii) of B, evals stay priced. | Teaching lands without a round; evals still send cards through the box when a file is full. | skills · 1 PR · S |
| **D** per-bundle budget | One ceiling per skill directory instead of per file; room moves between files of the same skill. | Fewer walls, but a file can grow while a sibling shrinks, and the per-file dedup pressure weakens. | skills · 1 PR · M · no precedent |

业务含义直译：A 是「每次加一页都要老板签字，哪怕是考题本」；B 是「考题本不算页数，正文加页要先删废话、按老板已定的规矩自己办」；C 是「正文按规矩自己办，考题本仍要签字」；D 是「按整本书限页，不按章节」。

## 四维分析

- **① 项目长远合理性（领起）。** 这道门护的是客户会话的上下文成本，两年后也该如此：发进客户项目、被加载的文字只降不升，新增以删复述付账。evals 不进上下文，给它计价是把「仓库体积」误标成「客户成本」，还与 #26369 B「协议新增必补 eval」结构性相撞。B 让门禁只护它真能护的面，并把你已裁的付账方式从评论先例升为门禁认可的路径（同 #23606 对线 ratchet 的裁法）。A 保留一个会反复撞的矛盾；D 削弱逐文件的去重压力。
- **② 实际业务拉动。** 实测：一条 eval 走了约 20 小时、三个席位；10 月四张卡只因文件满而存在；常设裁决被引用 40 次说明需求是常态不是例外。
- **③ 防 AI 犯错。** 门禁真正的防错价值是「加教学先删复述」，B 的 (ii) 保留它并要求 diff 里看得见删除；evals 本身就是防 AI 写错元数据的计分器，让它们随协议新增落地是加强防错，不是削弱。
- **④ 创业阶段不扩散。** B 不加门禁、不加文件，是对既有门禁的减肢（SKILL.md 升级与决策 ④：门禁只减不增）；D 是改形而非减肢。

os-decision-facets
① 长远：门禁只护客户上下文真会加载的文字；evals 计价是误标，且与 #26369 B 相撞；B 把既裁付账路径机械化（同 #23606 B）
② 拉动：#26940 一条 eval 约 20 小时三席位；10 月四张「文件满」跟进卡；常设裁决引用 40 次
③ 防错：保留「先删复述再加」的压力并要求 diff 可见；evals 随协议新增落地是加强防错
④ 不扩散：B 是既有门禁的减肢，不加门禁不加文件；D 改形
Prior rulings read: token ceiling, ratchet, 天花板, evals → 10402 ruling (header), 2026-10-27 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」, #23606 B (line ratchet), #26369 B, #12392; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## Recommendation

**B.** 只看①选 B；②③④ 是否翻转：否。Not A: it keeps a known contradiction and a 20-hour round per owed eval. Not C: it leaves the mis-priced population in place. Not D: it trades the per-file dedup pressure, which is the gate's measured value, for flexibility nobody asked for. Confidence gap: whether a Claude Code consumer ever reads `evals/*.json` into context by its own choice was not measured (no SKILL.md points there, and the README states inert); if a harness does, (i) should instead move evals to a separate, looser budget rather than out of the count.

## After the ruling

- **B or C:** the skills seat files no new card — this card is the execution card: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`, `domain:skills`; one PR edits the ratchet header, the population filter (B only) and the self-test rows, quoting this ruling; Tier by face (`scripts/**`, not governed; the skills seat lands it after review).
- **A:** close `not_planned`; the 10-27 standing ruling stays a comment-level precedent.
- **D:** the skills seat re-presents a per-bundle design before building.

## Related

#26940 (the trigger) · #26633 · #26760 · #26764 · #26834 · #23606 · #26369 · #12392 · #10473 · `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` · `skills/README.md`

## Dedupe

Titles of the last 1,000 objectstack issues (all states) grepped for `ratchet|ceiling|天花板|token cap`: #23606 (the LINE ratchet's twin question, ruled B), four closed eval follow-ups above, #23770 (closed, os-dev contract vs a ruled raise). No open card asks this question.
